context.transcript:
Hello, Amanda.
Do you have a few minutes to discuss the feedback I received on the training seminar I presented to the new engineers last week?
Sure.
I heard that the comments were generally very positive.
The new hires said your explanations were very clear.
Yes.
However, they did mention that it was a lot of information to absorb in a short time.
I was thinking that the next time I do this, I'd give them a break halfway through the seminar.
What do you think?
That's a good idea.
And maybe you could also set aside a half hour at the end so you'll have more time to answer all of the trainees' questions.
context.transcript_translation:
你好，Amanda。
你有没有几分钟时间讨论一下我上周向新工程师们展示的培训研讨会收到的反馈？
当然可以。
我听说评论总体上是非常积极的。
新员工说你的解释非常清楚。
是的。
但是，他们提到吸收这么多信息在短时间内有点困难。
我在想下次我做这个的时候，应该在中途给他们一个休息时间。
你觉得呢？
这是个好主意。
而且也许你可以在最后留出半小时，这样你就有更多的时间回答所有受训者的问题。
